notes: plain=uninstrumented micro-batch step (fwd+bwd+clip+AdamW, inputs resident); hooked=CUDA-event module envelopes without internal sync; forest_internal uses collect_timing (syncs at forest end); staged detaches graph boundaries and synchronizes phases; profiler numbers come from separate profiled runs and carry profiler overhead; kernel_active is CPU-op self device time attributed to the innermost timestamp range; gpu_busy_union is the union of device event intervals.
